increment: Top-level daemon and worker compilation charging
method: Same-host serial release measurements of identical fixture before and after source edits. One warmup and five measured rounds, median; 1000 evaluations per round. Includes compilation, fresh cached realm, execution, and result validation. No concurrent agent builds/tests during timing. Timing is total seconds for 1000 evaluations; raw and computrons are per evaluation, not aggregate.
limitations: One pair of same-host medians is not a statistical significance claim. Scalar timing is about 2% slower; intrinsic-heavy timing about 16% slower.
The meter-2 rollout now reaches top-level daemon and worker compilation; raw charges intentionally increase. This is the same unmerged cost-table release as runtime compilation charging.
These timings cover stateless daemon lifecycle; worker and persistent-path correctness have separate tests.
